An NSE trading desk that backtests first and trades carefully.

A full-stack platform for Indian equities: 28 documented strategies backtested across about 2,000 NSE symbols, a live market scanner every 60 seconds, Telegram alerts, and a supervised executor for real orders through Dhan.

See the builder's portfolio Open the app

Private, running on my own server. Live execution is supervised. The app needs a sign-in; this page is the public overview.

What it does

The parts that make Smart Trader different, in plain terms.

  • 28 strategies, backtested

    Every strategy is documented and backtested across the NSE universe before it sees live data.

  • A live scanner

    Scans the market every 60 seconds and pushes breakouts over WebSocket and Telegram.

  • Charts and risk

    Candlestick charting with portfolio and risk tracking.

  • Supervised live execution

    Sizes positions with a 2% risk cap, places broker-side protective stops, squares off before the close and reconciles with the broker on restart. Fail-safe, not yet proven autonomous.

How it's built

Designed, built and run end to end by one engineer.

  • React + Vite
  • NestJS
  • Prisma
  • Socket.io
  • Python FastAPI
  • pandas-ta
  • PostgreSQL 16
  • Nx
